mapper.sql: select inv.inventory_id, inv.input_id, ai.input_name, ai.sku as input_sku, ai.type as input_type, CASE ai.type WHEN 'pesticide' THEN '农药' WHEN 'fertilizer' THEN '化肥' WHEN 'seed' THEN '种子' ELSE '' END as input_type_desc, inv.batch_no, inv.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, inv.current_quantity, inv.in_date, inv.expired_date, inv.stock_status, CASE inv.stock_status WHEN '0' THEN '正常' WHEN '1' THEN '临期' WHEN '2' THEN '过期' ELSE '' END as stock_status_desc, datediff(inv.expired_date, curdate()) as days_to_expire, inv.create_people, inv.create_time, inv.update_people, inv.update_time from inv_inventory inv left join agri_input ai on inv.input_id = ai.input_id and ai.del_flag = '0' left join inv_warehouse w on inv.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id and w.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select:
where inv.del_flag = '0' and inv.current_quantity > 0
and inv.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
and inv.stock_status = '1'
and inv.stock_status = '2'
and inv.stock_status in ('1', '2')
order by inv.expired_date, inv.create_time desc
mapper.update: update inv_inventory set current_quantity = current_quantity + #{quantityChange}, update_time = now() where inventory_id = #{inventoryId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select concat('INV-', date_format(now(), '%Y%m%d'), '-', lpad(ifnull(max(substring(inventory_id, 14)), 0) + 1, 4, '0')) as inventory_id from inv_inventory where inventory_id like concat('INV-', date_format(now(), '%Y%m%d'), '%') and del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: update inv_inventory set stock_status = case when expired_date < curdate() then '2' when datediff(expired_date, curdate()) <= 30 then '1' else '0' end, update_time = now() where del_flag = '0'
